terra.problem: Luke 10:38 says Martha welcomed Jesus into her home. It does not say Mary hosted Him or that the home belonged to both sisters.
The passage does not say whether they waved or that they sent word to Jesus. It says only that He was told.
The passage does not say how long they waited. Calling it a long wait adds a duration, even as a guess.
Saying nobody is going up steps asserts a detail the passage does not give.
The passage mentions no door, does not say why Jesus was told, and does not establish where His family would have been if they were inside.
The guess about seats in a front row adds details about the setting that the passage does not give.
